query: 'SELECT
    patient_id AS patient_id_bk,

    full_name AS nombre_completo,

    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(gender))) IN ('MALE', 'M', 'MASCULINO')
            THEN 'Masculino'
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(gender))) IN ('FEMALE', 'F', 'FEMENINO')
            THEN 'Femenino'
        ELSE 'Otro'
    END AS genero,

    date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento,

    CASE
        WHEN date_of_birth IS NULL THEN NULL

        WHEN
            DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE())
            -
            CASE
                WHEN DATEADD(
                    YEAR,
                    DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()),
                    date_of_birth
                ) > GETDATE()
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END <= 18
            THEN '0-18'

        WHEN
            DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE())
            -
            CASE
                WHEN DATEADD(
                    YEAR,
                    DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()),
                    date_of_birth
                ) > GETDATE()
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END <= 35
            THEN '19-35'

        WHEN
            DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE())
            -
            CASE
                WHEN DATEADD(
                    YEAR,
                    DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()),
                    date_of_birth
                ) > GETDATE()
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END <= 60
            THEN '36-60'

        ELSE '60+'
    END AS rango_etario,

    email AS correo_electronico,

    address AS direccion,

    COALESCE(insurance_provider, 'Sin seguro') AS proveedor_seguro

FROM silver.patients',
